description: "Text analysis of Reddit posts links the Great Resignation to a pandemic-era surge in mental health and work-related distress discourse."
---

We use text analysis to investigate the changes in work- and quit-related posts between 2018 and 2021 on Reddit. We find that mental health and work-related distress topics disproportionally increased among quit-related posts since the onset of the pandemic, likely contributing to the Great Resignation.

![](/images/great-resignation-reddit-topics.png){fig-alt="Bar chart of topic prevalence shifts in quit-related Reddit posts before and after March 2020"}

References

- del Rio-Chanona, R. Maria, et al. "Mental health concerns precede quits: shifts in the work discourse during the Covid-19 pandemic and great resignation" *EPJ Data Science (2023)*. [Read here](https://epjds.epj.org/articles/epjdata/abs/2023/01/13688_2023_Article_417/13688_2023_Article_417.html)
